question: What is a Pokémon vending machine?
answer: An automated retail machine that sells official Pokémon Trading Card Game products like booster packs and Elite Trainer Boxes. They're stocked by The Pokémon Company International, so everything inside is authentic.

question: How do I use the map?
answer: Search a city or address from the home page or the map. The map opens on that area and lists every location inside your radius, closest first. Zoom out to see the whole country, or pick a state to explore it.

question: Are the vending machine locations verified?
answer: Yes. Locations come from the official retailer list on the [Pokémon Center website](https://support.pokemoncenter.com/hc/en-us/sections/13360842288916-Pok%C3%A9mon-Automated-Retail-Vending-Machines).

question: What information is available for each location?
answer: Each vending machine shows its retailer, address, machine ID and a Google Maps link. Signed-in users can read and leave reviews.

question: Can I filter locations?
answer: Yes. Choose which kinds of places to show and set a search radius of 5, 10, 25 or 50 miles.

question: How can I add a new location?
answer: Vending machines come from the official list, so report a missing one through [Support](https://discord.gg/f2uUR5bAZU). Adding card shops and events yourself is coming soon.

question: Can I report outdated or incorrect information?
answer: Yes. Send it to us through [Support](https://discord.gg/f2uUR5bAZU) and we'll fix it.

question: Do I need an account?
answer: No. Anyone can browse the map. An account lets you write reviews.

question: Is PokeFindr available outside the US?
answer: Not yet. Other countries appear grey on the map until we add them.

question: Is this an official Pokémon website?
answer: No. PokeFindr is a fan-made resource and is not affiliated with The Pokémon Company International.
